perspective:
Ethan Mohamud’s available information:

- He is long-time friends with Gary Guo; they met in middle school. Gary is a doctor.
- He has noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep.
- He is concerned about Gary’s health and invites him to a weekend retreat for relaxation/rejuvenation.
- He tells Gary: his health is just as important; he hates seeing Gary like this; two days might give him a new perspective.
- He hears Gary decline, saying he appreciates the concern but cannot because there is too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, he observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspects there is more to Gary’s overworking than professional obligations.
- He confronts Gary: they have been friends since middle school; Gary can tell him anything; Ethan is there to help, not judge.
- He hears Gary say it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
- Gary opens up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges.
- Ethan feels relief and empathy, and offers to help Gary find a better balance.
- Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating some responsibilities, telling Gary he does not have to do everything himself.
- Gary agrees that help organizing his schedule could make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary, discusses his progress and challenges, and sees Gary making efforts to change.
- Ethan feels hopeful and proud, and continues offering support and encouragement.
- He tells Gary he is proud of the progress and is there whenever Gary needs to talk.
- Gary tells Ethan things are better, Ethan’s help has reduced his overwhelm, and he had time for a movie last weekend.
- After a year, Ethan sees Gary managing on his own and feels satisfied and happy for him.
- Ethan decides to step back but tells Gary he is always just a call away and knows Gary has got this.
- Gary thanks Ethan, says he could not have done it without his support, and feels more in control now.
